_note: Edit me here OR on github.com in the mobile app, then tray right-click > Sync from GitHub. label = button text. category = chip group + dot color (Act green, Think blue, Tidy yellow, Forge orange). text = pasted text. enter omitted = default below. First 8 prompts get Ctrl+Alt+1..8. The rest are grid-click or search, but still work as /commands and agent tools.

prompts.label: Go
prompts.text: go

prompts.label: Fix errors
prompts.text: Fix the current errors. Show the exact failing check, apply the smallest fix, re-run the narrow check, and report a short receipt.

prompts.label: Explain
prompts.text: Explain what this code does, step by step, in short simple English.

prompts.label: Review diff
prompts.text: Review the current diff for bugs, style, and perf. List issues by file:line, then fix the smallest set and re-verify.

prompts.label: Write test
prompts.text: Write a narrow test for this change and run it. Report pass/fail with the exact command used.

prompts.label: Make plan
prompts.text: Make a short bounded plan for the next milestone: goal, 3-5 steps, verify step, stop condition. No code yet.

prompts.label: Commit
prompts.text: Commit scoped changes on main with a short message. Show git status first, commit only the listed paths.

prompts.label: Clean up
prompts.text: Clean up only what blocks the next proof. No broad refactors, no new tools.

prompts.label: Summarize
prompts.text: Summarize so far in 5 short bullets: done, now, next, blockers.

prompts.label: Explain error
prompts.text: Explain this error in short simple English: what broke, why, and the smallest fix.

prompts.label: Continue
prompts.text: Continue. Smallest next step, verify it, report a short receipt.

prompts.label: Ship it
prompts.text: Last check: review the diff, run the narrow test, commit scoped. Report receipt.

prompts.label: Brainstorm
prompts.text: Give 3 ways to do this with trade-offs. Short.

prompts.label: Simplify
prompts.text: Simplify this code. Same behavior. Short note on what changed.

prompts.label: Document
prompts.text: Add short comments and docs to this code. Nothing else.

prompts.label: Undo
prompts.text: Undo the last change safely with git. Show status first.

prompts.label: Forge health
prompts.text: In C:\forge: run health.summary, then state.read for the top state. Short simple words. Name the red gates.

prompts.label: Forge map
prompts.text: In C:\forge: read MAP.md. Say which dir and verb my task needs. Short.

prompts.label: Forge play
prompts.text: In C:\forge: play.run the current scene, then play.capture the hero frame. Report frames + errors.

prompts.label: Forge compile
prompts.text: In C:\forge: run code.compile. Fix only red, re-run. Short receipt.

prompts.label: Forge record
prompts.text: In C:\forge: save what we just did in records/ as proof. One short file.
